summary: Added application-level regressions proving client-scoped hire-case completion and submission cannot mutate another client's aggregate.
Verified valid owner completion records the injected UTC audit time and increments the optimistic version once.
Verified a stale owner version preserves the untouched checklist item and reports the stable concurrency business error.
Added nine source-grounded learning chapters that trace route identity, repository keys, aggregate transitions, testing, and operational limits.

checks.command: Recorded test runs and build/type checks

limits: The project uses singleton in-memory repositories and does not prove durable or distributed transaction behavior.
ClientId is supplied by the teaching API route; authentication and organization membership are outside this change.
The targeted application test project was run; no external providers, databases, or broad solution checks were used.
